jobs.title: Senior Ruby Backend Engineer with affinity for observability (d/w/m)
jobs.description:
Hypofriend has helped thousands of customers navigate the difficult journey of buying a home. Our online platform helps customers from calculating their affordability to getting matched to relevant properties to calculating and processing the optimal mortgage. 
 As a Senior Backend Engineer with an affinity for observability, you would be supporting both a customer-facing and an advisor-facing product that run on Vue.js, GraphQL, and Ruby on Rails, powered by AWS. Our customer-facing products include complex calculators wrapped in a simple UI, with a powerful calculation engine that takes thousands of mortgage products and optimizes them for our customers. 
 Our advisor-facing products include a fully-fledged back-office that ensures customer interactions over email, chat, and telephone — as well as the processing and handling of mortgage applications and financial documents — are reliable, efficient, and secure. 
 You'll help ensure our calculation engines, back-office tools, and customer-facing platform become more resilient and secure as we grow. 
 Tasks 
 💪🏽 Individuals who like getting things done 
 💬 Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with backend engineers and product teams 
 🔍 Eagerness to understand the systems end-to-end, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on 
 🔧 Someone who is as comfortable writing infrastructure-as-code as they are debugging a production incident 
 📈 A pragmatic approach to reliability — building the right amount of resilience, focussing on the key building blocks and clean architecture 
  Our technology stack  
 ⚙️  Backend  
 
 Ruby 4.0 (Rails 8.1) 
 PostgreSQL 16 
 Serverless Ruby, Node.JS, Python 
 
 🖌️  Frontend  
 
 Vue.js 3 
 CSS3 (flex & friends) 
 
 👷🏽  Infrastructure  
 
 AWS: ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront 
 Terraform for infrastructure-as-code 
 CI/CD pipelines 
 
 🔍  Testing & Reliability  
 
 RSpec 
 Monitoring & alerting tooling 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Strong commercial experience with  Ruby  (min 4-5 years), ideally including  Ruby on Rails 7/8  
  RSpec  experience 
 Good grasp of  OO patterns  
  Sentry ,  GitHub  and  Datadog  are your best friends 
 Hands-on production experience with  Terraform  for infrastructure-as-code 
 Working knowledge of  AWS  (ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, VPC networking, IAM) 
 Experience building and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines  
 Solid understanding of  observability : monitoring, logging, and alerting 
 Experience with  containerization  (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes) 
 Comfort with  incident response : on-call rotations, postmortems, and root-cause analysis 
 Good grasp of  RDBMS  operations ( PostgreSQL 16+ ) — backups, performance tuning, failover 
 A security-first mindset: familiarity with secrets management, least-privilege access, and cloud security best practices 
 
  Nice to have  
 
 Experience with  serverless Ruby, Node.JS  architectures 
 Familiarity with  GitHub Actions  
 Experience defining and tracking  SLIs/SLOs/error budgets  
 Scripting/automation experience beyond Ruby (Bash, Python) 
 Prior experience in a regulated industry (fintech, proptech, or similar) 
 
 Benefits 
  What can Hypofriend offer you?  
 👪 A young, motivated, and interdisciplinary team with years of experience building successful digital products 
 🏠 Work up to 100% from home, with occasional meetings and off-sites near our Berlin Headquarters 
 💥 In addition to an attractive fixed salary, you get the exciting opportunity to improve the German mortgage industry and be at the forefront of new and innovative practices 
 📈 Stock options in a growing company 
 💰 An 1,500 annual euro Learning budget 
 💼 As a young and rapidly growing company you have an excellent career perspective 
 💻 Latest Macbook and equipment to work from home 
 🏃🏼‍♂️ Urban Sports Membership 
 📍 A unique 3-story office at Rosenthaler Platz 
 🏡 Full support to become a homeowner 
 Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

new_jobs.title: Senior Ruby Backend Engineer with affinity for observability (d/w/m)
new_jobs.description:
Hypofriend has helped thousands of customers navigate the difficult journey of buying a home. Our online platform helps customers from calculating their affordability to getting matched to relevant properties to calculating and processing the optimal mortgage. 
 As a Senior Backend Engineer with an affinity for observability, you would be supporting both a customer-facing and an advisor-facing product that run on Vue.js, GraphQL, and Ruby on Rails, powered by AWS. Our customer-facing products include complex calculators wrapped in a simple UI, with a powerful calculation engine that takes thousands of mortgage products and optimizes them for our customers. 
 Our advisor-facing products include a fully-fledged back-office that ensures customer interactions over email, chat, and telephone — as well as the processing and handling of mortgage applications and financial documents — are reliable, efficient, and secure. 
 You'll help ensure our calculation engines, back-office tools, and customer-facing platform become more resilient and secure as we grow. 
 Tasks 
 💪🏽 Individuals who like getting things done 
 💬 Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with backend engineers and product teams 
 🔍 Eagerness to understand the systems end-to-end, from application code to the infrastructure it runs on 
 🔧 Someone who is as comfortable writing infrastructure-as-code as they are debugging a production incident 
 📈 A pragmatic approach to reliability — building the right amount of resilience, focussing on the key building blocks and clean architecture 
  Our technology stack  
 ⚙️  Backend  
 
 Ruby 4.0 (Rails 8.1) 
 PostgreSQL 16 
 Serverless Ruby, Node.JS, Python 
 
 🖌️  Frontend  
 
 Vue.js 3 
 CSS3 (flex & friends) 
 
 👷🏽  Infrastructure  
 
 AWS: ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront 
 Terraform for infrastructure-as-code 
 CI/CD pipelines 
 
 🔍  Testing & Reliability  
 
 RSpec 
 Monitoring & alerting tooling 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Strong commercial experience with  Ruby  (min 4-5 years), ideally including  Ruby on Rails 7/8  
  RSpec  experience 
 Good grasp of  OO patterns  
  Sentry ,  GitHub  and  Datadog  are your best friends 
 Hands-on production experience with  Terraform  for infrastructure-as-code 
 Working knowledge of  AWS  (ECS, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, VPC networking, IAM) 
 Experience building and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines  
 Solid understanding of  observability : monitoring, logging, and alerting 
 Experience with  containerization  (Docker, ECS or Kubernetes) 
 Comfort with  incident response : on-call rotations, postmortems, and root-cause analysis 
 Good grasp of  RDBMS  operations ( PostgreSQL 16+ ) — backups, performance tuning, failover 
 A security-first mindset: familiarity with secrets management, least-privilege access, and cloud security best practices 
 
  Nice to have  
 
 Experience with  serverless Ruby, Node.JS  architectures 
 Familiarity with  GitHub Actions  
 Experience defining and tracking  SLIs/SLOs/error budgets  
 Scripting/automation experience beyond Ruby (Bash, Python) 
 Prior experience in a regulated industry (fintech, proptech, or similar) 
 
 Benefits 
  What can Hypofriend offer you?  
 👪 A young, motivated, and interdisciplinary team with years of experience building successful digital products 
 🏠 Work up to 100% from home, with occasional meetings and off-sites near our Berlin Headquarters 
 💥 In addition to an attractive fixed salary, you get the exciting opportunity to improve the German mortgage industry and be at the forefront of new and innovative practices 
 📈 Stock options in a growing company 
 💰 An 1,500 annual euro Learning budget 
 💼 As a young and rapidly growing company you have an excellent career perspective 
 💻 Latest Macbook and equipment to work from home 
 🏃🏼‍♂️ Urban Sports Membership 
 📍 A unique 3-story office at Rosenthaler Platz 
 🏡 Full support to become a homeowner 
 Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow
